reason: Removes write amplification and retention leaks found during the lifecycle batch. (1) MIS-7/MIS-9: automation_runtime reuses the captured stream artifact as the redacted reference when redaction changes no bytes (a differing redacted copy is still written); ToolOutputService search skips a redacted twin of a stream it already searches; StoreToolEvidenceRecorder stops writing empty stdout/stderr placeholders for tools that produced no process output, and skips an MCP structured_content block that a text block already serializes. Receipt artifact, Evidence and ToolCall.result are kept. (2) delete_chat_session and delete_archived_engagement remove chat_turn_step_events and chat_turn_checkpoints of the deleted turns. (3) Grok ACP notifications Nebula ignores are counted on the terminal event instead of stored as notice rows; unhandled requests keep their notice. (4) Mission harness activity_events filters the run ledger to the turn's harness rows in SQL. Selected: the new regression file; the automation runtime/broker, callback webhook, storage, Grok ACP, harness command/activity/adapter, MCP probe, web search, structured results, SSH, browser companion and tool-failure suites (recorder and receipt consumers); the conversation/project deletion suites (archived project, temporary chat, guarded delete, chat API, subagent lifecycle); chat catch-up and the chat tool loop (harness activity and command receipts); missions; and test_harnesses.py and test_tool_catalog.py (gateway MCP receipts, activity replay, mission harness turns, catalog MCP calls).
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. test_api.py (the harness activity endpoint) is excluded: the endpoint delegates to activity_events, which the selection covers directly. No UI, Playwright, native Rust/Tauri or migration changes: no schema change, old rows keep validating, and existing redacted twins stay readable by id.
